issue.title: Root the daily ^gtd row at gtd and give areas and projects configurable colors
issue.description: New daily notes root their ^gtd row at gtd.md and the built-in Review time keeps counting that time. Any area or project note can set its own color with a `color:` slot, either a palette hue or grey, and every Bob surface honors it, so the gtd area renders grey like the PLAN type in the Day and period stats strips.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/gtd_root_and_area_colors.md requests this work
